🐛 Pest Risk Forecast — Rice

How this works: recent temperature, humidity and rainfall patterns are scored against known favorable conditions for this crop's key pest, producing a 0–100% risk score for each upcoming day.

Loading pest risk forecast…

💧 Irrigation Advisory

How this works: soil moisture is estimated from a rainfall + evapotranspiration water-balance model (no sensor needed), then compared to the crop's ideal range and the next 2 days' rain forecast.

Loading irrigation advice…

🌱 Crop Recommendation

How this works: average temperature, humidity and rainfall over the last 30 days are compared against each crop's ideal requirement bands to produce a suitability ranking.

Loading crop rankings…

📷 Crop Disease / Pest Detection

How this works: upload a leaf photo, and a CNN (MobileNet/EfficientNet fine-tuned on PlantVillage) classifies the problem, returning confidence + a treatment plan. Prototype note: this demo wires the full interface end-to-end with a placeholder detector — real model training is a separate build step.

📤 Click to upload a leaf/crop photo
